mapper.select: SELECT id, symbol, market, valuation_note, valuation_checked_at, active, created_at FROM auto_trade_candidate WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auto_trade_candidate (symbol, market, valuation_note, valuation_checked_at, active, created_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{market}, #{valuationNote}, #{valuationCheckedAt}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
